The '''M0-GUL Thrall Droid''' was a type of mouse droid used during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The M0-GUL Thrall Droid appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where it is a pet that can be acquired during the "Karagga's Palace" Operation.
